# S-Bike Training Hub

> Free, local-first training hub for a budget smart bike (built and tested on the Merach S29; other Bluetooth FTMS bikes may work). It holds the bike's single Bluetooth connection and shares it with a watch and a training app, turns route grades into resistance with virtual gears and auto-shifting, runs ERG workouts that pause and resume, and scores training load across every sport from the watch (bike, run, swim, walk, gym). Runs entirely on a Mac: no subscription, no cloud. Includes an MCP server so an AI assistant can coach the rider day by day.

Fixes common Merach S29 problems: only one Bluetooth connection (so a watch and Zwift/Kinomap can't both connect), hills not changing resistance, no gears or virtual shifting, ERG grinding the rider to a stop.

Good fit for someone who: owns a Merach S29 or similar FTMS smart bike and wants hills, gears and ERG without a subscription app; trains for triathlon or several sports and wants one load picture across them; wants their AI assistant to read their training data and plan the next day; rides indoors on a Mac.

Requirements: macOS with Bluetooth, Python 3, a smart bike (Merach S29 tested). A COROS or other watch exporting .fit files is optional (for heart rate, runs and swims).

## MCP server

- [mcp_server.py](https://github.com/JHarp199345/S-Bike-Training-Hub/blob/main/mcp_server.py): stdio MCP server "s-bike-hub", standard library only, 38 tools (today's verdict and plan, morning check-ins, rides and ride stories, fitness and body-system load, watch file import, swim/run/ride insights, workouts and timed workouts, route planning and climb goals, calibration tests). It talks to the hub on the same Mac (http://127.0.0.1:8729); the hub must be running.
- Setup: `claude mcp add --scope user s-bike-hub -- python3 /path/to/S-Bike-Training-Hub/mcp_server.py`

## Features

- Bluetooth bridge: one bike connection shared with a watch (power + cadence) and a training app (Kinomap, etc.)
- Offline 3D routes with a local route planner; virtual hills, gears, auto-shifting and virtual speed
- ERG workouts in zones around each block's target; pause, auto-pause and resume after an interruption
- Game view: a side-scroller for workouts and rides without a map route
- Coach: daily verdict from check-ins and watch data, week plan with ride/swim/run sessions, progress and calibration tests
- Training load for bike, run, swim, walk and gym on three body systems; running "blocks" with a hop test; swim recovery fitted to shoulder reports
- What the watch saw: swim stroke breakdown (SWOLF), run form splits, ride heart-rate recovery, pauses
